title: Two of everything
summary: Say 'two' with the dual ending ـَانِ / ـَيْنِ: كُوبَانِ (two glasses), شَطِيرَتَيْنِ (two sandwiches).
intro: Arabic has a special form for exactly two: the dual. Add ـَانِ to the noun: كُوب (glass) → كُوبَانِ (two glasses). After a verb or a preposition the ending is ـَيْنِ: أُرِيدُ كُوبَيْنِ. A feminine ة turns into ت, and now you hear it: شَطِيرَة (sandwich) → شَطِيرَتَانِ. The dual already means 'two', so you don't need the number اِثْنَانِ.
objectives: Make the dual of masculine and feminine nouns
Use ـَانِ as subject and ـَيْنِ after a verb or preposition
Make an adjective agree with a dual noun
Order two drinks and two sandwiches at a juice shop

realLife.title: The juice shop
realLife.story: On Saturday morning Daniel and Layla stop at a juice shop on the way to a study session. It is hot, Daniel is very thirsty, and he orders two glasses of juice for himself. Layla buys sandwiches: two for them, and one ful sandwich as a surprise for Sami.

mistakes.why: The dual ending already means 'two': kitābāni is 'two books'. Don't count with the number two.

sentences.literal: I want two sandwiches, from your kindness

mistakes.why: After a verb (here: the object of أُرِيدُ) the dual ending is -ayni, not -āni.

sentences.en: We are two friends from two different countries.
sentences.literal: we (are) two friends from two countries two different

sentences.en: In the class there are two students from Lebanon. (women)
sentences.literal: in the class (are) two (female) students from Lebanon

mistakes.why: Before the dual ending, ة is written as an open ت: ṭālibatāni.

dialogue.title: Two glasses for Daniel
dialogue.culture: Juice shops are everywhere in Cairo, with fruit hanging at the door: mango, orange, sugar cane and banana with milk. A small shop is a مَحَلّ. When the seller speaks to two people he uses the dual: أَهْلًا بِكُمَا (welcome, you two).

lines.ar: صَبَاحُ الْخَيْر يَا شَبَاب! أَهْلًا بِكُمَا فِي مَحَلِّ الْعَصِير.
lines.en: Good morning, young people! Welcome, you two, to the juice shop.

lines.ar: صَبَاحُ النُّور! نَحْنُ صَدِيقَانِ جَائِعَانِ وَعَطْشَانَانِ جِدًّا!
lines.en: Good morning! We are two very hungry and thirsty friends!

lines.ar: مَاذَا تُرِيدَانِ؟ عِنْدَنَا عَصِير مَانْجُو وَبُرْتُقَال، وَمَوْز بِالْحَلِيب.
lines.en: What would you two like? We have mango juice and orange juice, and banana with milk.

lines.ar: أُرِيدُ كُوبًا كَبِيرًا مِنْ عَصِيرِ الْمَانْجُو، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ.
lines.en: I'd like a large glass of mango juice, please.

lines.ar: وَأَنَا أُرِيدُ كُوبَيْنِ: وَاحِدًا مِنَ الْبُرْتُقَال، وَوَاحِدًا مِنَ الْمَوْز بِالْحَلِيب!
lines.en: And I'd like two glasses: one of orange, and one of banana with milk!

lines.ar: كُوبَانِ يَا دَانْيَال؟ أَنْتَ عَطْشَان جِدًّا الْيَوْم!
lines.en: Two glasses, Daniel? You really are thirsty today!

lines.ar: نَعَم! الْجَوّ حَارّ، وَأَنَا أُحِبُّ الْعَصِيرَ كَثِيرًا.
lines.en: Yes! The weather is hot, and I love juice very much.

lines.ar: وَهَلْ تُرِيدَانِ شَيْئًا لِلْأَكْل؟ عِنْدَنَا شَطَائِر فُول وَجُبْن وَبَيْض.
lines.en: And would you two like something to eat? We have ful, cheese and egg sandwiches.

lines.ar: نُرِيدُ شَطِيرَتَيْنِ مِنَ الْجُبْن، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، وَشَطِيرَةَ فُول وَاحِدَة.
lines.en: We'd like two cheese sandwiches, please, and one ful sandwich.

lines.ar: حَاضِر! شَطِيرَتَانِ مِنَ الْجُبْن، وَشَطِيرَة فُول، وَثَلَاثَة أَكْوَاب عَصِير.
lines.en: Certainly! Two cheese sandwiches, one ful sandwich and three glasses of juice.

lines.ar: يَا لَيْلَى، هَلِ الشَّطِيرَتَانِ لَكِ؟ أَنْتِ جَائِعَة جِدًّا!
lines.en: Layla, are both sandwiches for you? You must be very hungry!

lines.ar: لَا، وَاحِدَة لِي وَوَاحِدَة لَكَ. وَشَطِيرَةُ الْفُول لِسَامِي فِي الْمَدْرَسَة.
lines.en: No, one is for me and one is for you. And the ful sandwich is for Sami, at school.

lines.ar: فِكْرَة جَمِيلَة! سَامِي يُحِبُّ الْفُولَ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ أَيِّ طَعَام.
lines.en: What a lovely idea! Sami loves ful more than any other food.

lines.ar: تَفَضَّلَا، الشَّطَائِر وَالْعَصِير. بِالْهَنَاء وَالشِّفَاء يَا شَبَاب!
lines.en: Here you are, you two: the sandwiches and the juice. Enjoy your meal, young people!

reading.title: Saturday at the juice shop
reading.ar: يَوْمَ السَّبْت يَذْهَبُ دَانْيَال وَلَيْلَى إِلَى مَحَلِّ عَصِير. لَيْلَى تَشْرَبُ كُوبًا وَاحِدًا، وَدَانْيَال يَشْرَبُ كُوبَيْنِ! يَأْكُلَانِ شَطِيرَتَيْنِ مِنَ الْجُبْن.
reading.en: On Saturday Daniel and Layla go to a juice shop. Layla drinks one glass, and Daniel drinks two! The two of them eat two cheese sandwiches.
segs: go (the verb stays singular before its subject)

quiz.prompt: What happens to ة in the dual?
options: It is written ت and you hear the t

quiz.prompt: How many glasses of juice does Daniel order for himself?
Choose the correct sentence: 'The two glasses are big.'
Who is the ful sandwich for?

completion: Fantastic! You can talk about two of anything with the dual. Tomorrow: prices and numbers up to 100.
